name: io.liftoff.liftoffads.interstitials.UnifiedInterstitialActivity
description: Liftoff Ads opens this screen to display a unified full-screen interstitial ad. It renders the ad content and handles ad-viewing rewards and ad actions.
disableEffect: Rewards for watching this unified interstitial will no longer be granted; if the app requests one, Liftoff does not recover from a failed screen launch and the app may close.
